description: The single owner of the canonical refusal and could-not-observe reason codes, grouped into six namespaces. A code names WHAT was violated and therefore WHO repairs it. bin/fm-semantics-lib.sh is its only interpreter.
why: This fleet has established twice, in two landed mechanisms, that keeping refusal reasons apart is what lets an operator repair the right thing: bin/fm-outbound-artifact-lib.sh records that both a mismatch and an unobservable refuse, so a two-valued check is not unsafe but unreportable; bin/fm-landing-authorization-lib.sh keeps two token families apart because an operator told only that it did not work repairs the wrong thing. Six of the fourteen named laws in the commissioning architecture are refusal REASONS wearing a law's clothing. They keep their full force here and stop competing for the attention budget the five laws need.
authority_why: New on this branch. A reason code becomes authoritative for a mechanism only through that mechanism's inheritance manifest, and only once the adoption prerequisites in semantics/laws.json pass.

resolution_rule.rule: A code resolves to exactly one namespace by LOOKUP in this register, never by reading its prefix.
resolution_rule.why: Four observation-integrity codes carry an SFI_ or EFFECT_ prefix because those are the spellings the reviewed architecture ruled, and renaming them here to make prefixes sort cleanly would invent a distinction no ruling made. So the register is the resolver and the prefix is a naming convention. bin/fm-semantics.sh reason <code> performs the lookup, and the flat code-to-namespace map in the projection exists so a consumer never has to parse a prefix.
resolution_rule.enforced_by: the codes_unique_across_namespaces invariant below, which is what makes the lookup total and single-valued

namespaces.concern: a state that is neither honestly terminal nor honestly nonterminal
namespaces.owner_to_repair: the owner that declared the state

codes.means: the family is not a declared member of the vocabulary
codes.repair: map the value in semantics/state-families.json, or fix the producer; never default it

codes.means: a terminal family carries an open continuation obligation
codes.repair: either the state is not terminal or the obligation is discharged; both cannot be true

codes.means: a nonterminal family declares no owner, no wake, or no reobservation - a nonterminal state whose reobservation has never fired is not patient, it is orphaned
codes.repair: arm the wake, or move the state to the family that honestly describes it

codes.means: the state names a legal successor its family does not declare, so the successor set is not enumerable from the family alone
codes.repair: narrow the state, or extend the family in the owner where every consumer sees it

codes.means: more than one successor of a superseded predecessor is outside SUPERSEDED
codes.repair: supersede the extras; this is a COUNT, never a review question

namespaces.concern: evidence made in one context being consumed in another

codes.means: the target family is not in the source family's declared legal successors
codes.repair: take the declared path, or change the declared path in the owner

codes.means: a SUPERSEDED subject was moved back into a nonterminal family
codes.repair: create a successor subject; the predecessor stays where it is, permanently

codes.means: a verdict from one family was used to advance a subject in another - availability does not qualify, openness does not make actionable, a green check does not review, a passing review does not authorise landing
codes.repair: obtain the evidence the transition actually requires

codes.means: a REVISE state was promoted with no evidence addressing the finding
codes.repair: the MAKER addresses the finding; a checker verdict cannot discharge it

codes.means: the evidence's binding or generation differs from the context's and the contract declares that difference material
codes.repair: re-observe under the current binding; the old evidence stays attributed to the worker that produced it

codes.means: the evidence is unreadable, or every entry is NO_VERIFIER_RAN
codes.repair: repair the evidence source; this is never a pass and never a rejection

namespaces.concern: a subject being confused with a different subject, or a name granting a permission
namespaces.owner_to_repair: the declared owner of the namespace edge

codes.means: the resolved object names a DIFFERENT subject - a workspace read as a repository, a transport read as a subject, an artifact location read as a governed subject
codes.repair: resolve through the edge's declared owner

codes.means: membership in a pool, list, directory, filename or schema string was read as a capability, applicability or permission
codes.repair: hold a spendable authority object instead; a name grants nothing

codes.means: several candidates match and none is uniquely choosable
codes.repair: make the producer state its subject once; deliberately kept apart from a mismatch, because a mismatch says the one candidate found is not about this work while ambiguity says several were found and none can be chosen

codes.means: the namespace edge has zero declared owners, or two that disagree
codes.repair: declare exactly one owner; zero owners and two owners are the same defect - nobody is answerable

codes.means: recompiling the subject from the world yields a different digest
codes.repair: address the current subject; a moved head is a different subject, not a stale one

codes.means: the target namespace's own identity rule could not be determined, such as a repository object-format width
codes.repair: repair the observation; never default the rule

codes.means: no provenance record exists for the mapping
codes.repair: have the edge owner record provenance when it resolves

codes.means: the subject reference does not resolve to a compilation record
codes.repair: compile the subject at the point every input is knowable

namespaces.concern: an irreversible act whose intent or outcome is not recorded, or is recorded as the wrong one
namespaces.owner_to_repair: the owner that performs the effect

codes.means: a state before the commit point was rendered as committed
codes.repair: render the commit point as its own state; it is not one of its neighbours

codes.means: what the ruling approved, what the caller intends and what the world currently reports do not all agree
codes.repair: obtain a fresh authority for the current head; agreement of all three is the property and any two of them is one of its weaker neighbours

codes.means: the intent record could not be durably written before the act
codes.repair: repair the recorder; acting first is reachable by exactly one mistake and is not recoverable

codes.means: the authority for this exact subject is already spent
codes.repair: nothing - this is the control working; a duplicate wake converging on the same authority is the designed outcome

codes.means: no INDEPENDENT observation of the target establishes that the intended effect is now true
codes.repair: observe the target from a source other than the actor; the actor's own report is not the proof

codes.means: the act reported failure, or its outcome was not recorded, so whether it happened is unknown - this is an ANSWER, not an error
codes.repair: reconcile from an observation before any retry; a failed invocation does not prove NOT_APPLIED

codes.means: the effect target could not be observed at the pre-effect check
codes.repair: restore the observation; never proceed on an assumed target

namespaces.concern: a crossing between two owners whose vocabulary, version or producer is not what the reader assumed
namespaces.owner_to_repair: the seam's declared owner_to_repair, which is an EXISTING owner and never a new emitter

codes.means: a value crossed the seam that the total mapping does not declare
codes.repair: map it in the owner, or fix the producer; an unmapped value refuses rather than defaulting

codes.means: the seam is credited as qualified with no production-shaped crossing and no witnessed red
codes.repair: exercise the seam for real; a seam with tests and no crossing is NOT_YET_EXERCISED, which is not a pass

codes.means: two owners claim one side of the crossing
codes.repair: collapse to one; a seam defect never justifies a new emitter, registry, scheduler, watcher or bus

codes.means: the record declares a version this reader does not accept
codes.repair: negotiate a version; kept apart from a shape mismatch because the repairs differ

codes.means: the record carries an accepted version string but not the shape that version declares - a version string is not a format, and a reader that accepts a record because its schema field matches has checked a NAME
codes.repair: fix the producer

codes.means: the record was written into a shared namespace by a producer that namespace does not declare
codes.repair: declare the producer, or move the record; quarantine and PRESERVE the record, never delete it - it is evidence

codes.means: the record could not be parsed at all
codes.repair: kept apart from a semantic mismatch, and no prose fallback upgrades it to authority

namespaces.concern: an observation that did not happen, is out of date for the decision it is being used for, or performed an effect while pretending to look
namespaces.owner_to_repair: the owner of the probe or the evidence source

codes.means: the state carries no evidence, unreadable evidence, or only NO_VERIFIER_RAN entries - a state with zero evidence entries is not clean, it is unevidenced
codes.repair: observe it

codes.means: an evidence entry is outside its declared freshness and the caller is effect-proximal, so no cached permission may be served at any age
codes.repair: re-observe now; a refusal composes forward from an early gate but a permission never does

codes.means: the probe expression can succeed after a prior step failed, so it passes in any context where its dependencies vanish
codes.repair: one conjunction; assert every dependency inside the chain; give every non-existence assertion a positive control

codes.means: a probe made a durable change - an observation performed an effect
codes.repair: make the probe read-only; this is the sibling of a precommit claiming committed, arriving from the other side

codes.means: refresh cadence plus worst probe duration plus reconciliation and emission plus bounded jitter does not fit strictly inside the validity horizon, or the outer timeout does not exceed inner termination plus the typed-result emission margin
codes.repair: shorten the cadence or lengthen the horizon at the EXISTING timing owner; this is a predicate, not a timing framework

invariants: namespaces_unique: no two namespaces may share a name
codes_unique_across_namespaces: no code may be declared in more than one namespace, which is what makes namespace resolution a total single-valued lookup
code_verdict_declared: every code must declare a verdict of exactly REFUSE or CNO - PASS is never a reason
code_repair_declared: every code must name what to repair, because a refusal that does not say what to fix sends the operator to the wrong thing
namespace_owner_to_repair_declared: every namespace must name who repairs its class

six_namespaces: exactly six namespaces are declared - state-family, transition, identity, effect, seam and protocol, and observation and freshness - and a seventh needs a stated consumer-action difference before it may be added
